flags.message: The frozen band is `baseline` (one distribution, no CVSG), but the docket shows the Court called for a response on Jul 27 2026 after the Solicitor General waived. That call-for-response signal is not among the salience features and has no statpack cut, so the scored baseline understates this petition's position; the forecast adjusts up from the band anchor on the predictor's own estimate of the conditional rate.
